assets.name: book
assets.prompt: Precise-object-edit. Extract and recreate ONLY the open green-bound two-page magic book from the provided approved Dearvale UI. Production separate background asset for live HTML forms. Preserve its exact delicate 2D watercolor style, pale warm ivory subtly mottled paper, sage leather outer binding, soft page edges, thin layered pages, central binding seam, green ribbon bookmark below the center, soft shadows. Front-facing nearly flat topdown full spread with the same gentle outline as source, wide landscape about 2.4:1. BOTH pages must be completely BLANK including removing left wand/books/daisies illustration, all texts, all headings, labels, controls, buttons, progress, lock icon and ornament drawings INSIDE the pages. Keep light natural paper grain, small gold botanical flourishes at corners if subtle. Entire book fully within canvas with tight even 2% padding, no clipped edges or ribbon. Remove everything outside book, no app background, header, UI or botanical page corners. Actual alpha transparent outside book, not painted checkerboard. Bright cream clean center suitable for dark readable HTML forms. No 3D rendered look, no dark stains, no writing.
